_comment: Turn the log lines Mia already writes into CloudWatch metrics, so they can raise an alarm.
Nothing here changes application code. The lines exist and are well formed; until a metric
filter reads them, a Mia that is failing every turn looks identical to a Mia nobody used.
defaultValue=0 matters: without it the metric is missing rather than zero when Mia is idle,
and an alarm cannot tell 'healthy' from 'no data'.

Filters.Why: A turn that did not reach the person. Includes a composed customer reply the port never delivered, which is otherwise indistinguishable from a healthy turn.
Assaf asked something and the agent did not answer. reason= carries why: no_model_configured, provider_error, budget_exhausted.
An LLM provider failed the whole chain. A sustained non-zero rate here means the fallback chain is exhausted, not merely exercised.
A visitor recorded a voice note and got 'I could not hear that'. reason= separates stt_not_configured, provider_error and empty_transcript.
A provider refused a message Mia had already composed and paid for.
